definitions: To take on a task that is too big or difficult to handle.
To attempt to do too much.
examples: I think I bit off more than I could chew with this project.
She realized she had bitten off more than she could chew when the deadlines piled up.
Don't bite off more than you can chew, or you'll get stressed.
lemma: bite off more than one can chew
source: I bite off more than I can chew
